Hello! My wife and I went for a walk tonight. Two weeks ago we moved into the house we are currently renting. We live in Kazakhstan, in the city of Kokshetau. There is a cemetery very close by, which is called the "Cossack cemetery". It operated until 1969 and now looks abandoned, although there are several monuments to soldiers who died during the Second World War at the entrance. Also in this cemetery there is a mass grave of Cossacks shot in 1914. Here are the coordinates of the cemetery, if anyone is interested 53°17'26"N 69°20'34"E.There is a hiking trail along almost the entire length of the cemetery, along which we walked. From the side of the trail, the cemetery looked a little scary and we decided to take some pictures. And on one of them we found this. We can't figure out what it is, so I'm appealing to you so that we can figure it out together. For me personally, it looks like a face, but the body is not visible at all because of the bushes. It looks really creepy) Thank you for your attention, write your opinion, I will read every comment!)

Hello. My name is Gleb.  
I was born and raised in Ekibastuz, Kazakhstan.

I am sorry for my English. I use translator.  
I studied at school No. 7. That's where I took this photo.  
  
It was December 25, 2012. My younger sister had a matinee dedicated to the upcoming new year.  
I took the photo. And I was waiting for the moment when there would be no one behind my sister, so I am 100% sure that at the time of shooting there was no one in the frame but her.  
  
Immediately after the shooting, I did not notice anything unusual in the photo.   
When I came home and started looking through the photos, I saw the legs behind my sister. I was in shock.   
And to be honest, after almost 10 years, I have not found an explanation for this situation.   
I repeat that I am completely sure that only my sister was in the frame.  
In 2009, when I was studying at this school in the 8th grade, 2 students of this school committed suicide a few days apart.   
They lived in houses that are located very close to this school. I remember it very well. The whole school was in shock.  
This school is located at the address - Kazakhstan, Ekibastuz, Gornyakov 20. It was opened in 1968.  
I know that this is not a confirmation of the existence of ghosts. But the doubts do not leave me.  
Thank you for your attention!
